world_fit_review.observations: New v002 is an upright frog cast member with oversized round head, short torso, two arms ending in relaxed frog hands, two short supporting legs and large cream-sclera oval eyes with a gentle smile. It matches the cat/hedgehog/tiger proportions and replaces the crouching natural v001 idea.

geometry.anchor_measurement: Manual visual measurement in native source pixels; approximate anatomical registration, not a subpixel motion/alignment acceptance.
geometry.anchor_basis: Midpoint of the two broad drawn short-foot support regions. Entire upright head-to-foot body used as reference.
geometry.vertical_motion_policy: Grounded neutral; use anatomical foot support for consumer scene placement. No baked jump or vertical displacement.

resolution_review.basis: Registered body scale; source is not upscaled. Full visible appendages fit the displayed canvas; display quality is visually confirmed before final status.
resolution_review.visual_judgment: Native original plus light/dark composites at the recorded maximum reference size inspected. Species colour blocks, face, outlines and extremities remain clear; no visible alpha residue, clipped features or display-scale blur found.

species_review: Green frog skin and gold-brown mottling retained; Ishikawa frog species-group representative, not a diagnostic scientific plate.
transparency_review: Inspected native source plus separate light/dark composites. No source-alpha cleanup or pixel edits.
